jobs.title: Area Vice President, Southwest Ontario
jobs.description:
In This Role, You Will

Shape and execute the Canadian strategy in your Area, driving revenue, growth, and long‑term success.
Lead the development and delivery of Area business plans, budgets, and resource allocation to maximize efficiency and performance.
Sponsor and govern major cross‑functional and transformation initiatives at the country and divisional level.
Ensure outstanding service delivery, including new contract start‑ups, transitions, and shutdowns, with a relentless focus on client satisfaction and service excellence.
Oversee financial and administrative controls, including pricing, budgeting, and billing, in close partnership with Finance.
Present clear insights, risks, and opportunities to the Executive Team and influence key strategic decisions.
Build strong, trust‑based relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders; support national and global sales initiatives and major tenders.
Stay ahead of industry trends and competition, driving continuous improvement and innovative security solutions.
Provide inspirational leadership to Area and Branch teams, fostering high performance, accountability, and a culture of respect, diversity, inclusion, and engagement.
Lead positive labour relations, ensure timely resolution of grievances, and guide leaders on the interpretation of collective agreements.
Ensure robust governance, risk management, and compliance with all legislation, collective agreements, and Securitas policies.
Champion Securitas’ values and our commitment to health and safety, ethics, and sustainability across the Area.

Qualifications & Experience

Ten years of progressive management experience and a minimum of 7+ years of direct management experience with full P&L, and responsibility and team leadership for multi-Branch Operations, or related management experience working within a large complex organization.
Experience working within a unionized environment is an asset. Proven track record of delivering results and leading complex, multi-site or multi-country operations.
Experience with security technologies such as CCTV and Access Control and managing and/or delivering remote security services is an asset.
Strong strategic, analytical, and financial skills, with experience managing significant budgets.
Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, including experience with Senior Management and Executive stakeholders.
Experience working in a security related industry is preferred,
Demonstrated ability to lead transformation, manage change, and drive continuous improvement at scale.
Alignment with Securitas’ values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness.

What We Offer

An opportunity to contribute to a global leader in security services.
A supportive team environment focused on learning and growth.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
Competitive compensation and benefits in line with local market practices.

Securitas Canada is committed to nurturing a diverse workforce representative of the communities within which we operate. We encourage and are pleased to consider all qualified candidates, without regard to race, colour, citizenship, religion, sex, marital / family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, aboriginal status, age, disability or persons who may require an accommodation, to apply.

For accommodation requests during the hiring process, please contact inclusionandbelonging@securitas.ca for further information.

#AF-CanadaCorp

Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.
